title: Austin Airport Future & Reserve Site Plans
summary:
*   Discussions commenced on a Request for Proposals (RFP) for the Bergstrom Airport Master Plan, kickstarting long-term development strategies.
*   The committee reviewed three potential layouts for the Air Force Reserve Site, with a specific option (Site C) identified as the most feasible choice for future council approval.
*   An update was provided regarding concession opportunities for Disadvantaged Business Enterprises (DBE) at Robert Mueller Municipal Airport.

11:30 Α.Μ.
AVIATION SUBCOMMITTEE MEETING
QUORUM OF COUNCIL PRESENT
Mayor Pro Tem Urdy, chairman of the Aviation Subcommittee, called to order the meeting,
noting the presence of three other members of the Council: Councilmembers Epstein,
Nofziger and Larson.
The Subcommittee discussed the Bergstrom Master Plan Request for Proposals (RFP). A
transcript of the discussion is on file in the City Clerk's office.
The Subcommittee was shown three options for the Air Force Reserve Site. Joe Lessard said
the Council would have to approve the layout. Mayor Pro Tem Urdy said that Site C seemed
to be the one which would be feasible.
The final item on the agenda vas RMMA DBE concession update.
The meeting was adjourned at 12:25 Ρ.Μ.
